findings.observation: No application backup timer found in loaded or installed systemd units matching backup/restic/borg/duplicity/rclone. Only dpkg-db-backup.timer exists; it is not a MySQL/Nacos/Redis/Rabbit backup. 200/201 have manual backup script and historical local backup directory; 210 has neither matched tool nor backup directory in scanned paths.
limitations: No crontab contents or external scheduler read; names-only scan cannot exclude a custom task named without the backup-related patterns.
Tool presence does not prove current19 network guards, code SHA, successful backup, retention or restore status; no script was executed.
findings.recommendation: Main agent should define exact application-consistent scope, current19 UUID/role guards, destination capacity/permissions, retention/locking/failure notification, then prepare and review guest-only scheduled jobs. Keep prod/test outputs separate. Do not install or run a generic whole-private/whole-VM job; do not touch CF or publisher keys.
findings.required_followup: A real scheduled pipeline and dated success/failure evidence are still required before claiming automatic backups; independent destination and RPO/RTO remain separate acceptance items.
